proposals.name: Graphite Studio
proposals.tagline: Dark mineral texture. Clear worktops. Crisp light.
proposals.vibe: Quiet mineral texture, charcoal furniture and one restrained black-and-white print.
proposals.work_wall: Matte charcoal texture on the 4.2 m desk wall. A quiet peel-and-stick finish gives the simplest flexible accent; retain the exposed brick.
proposals.room_translation: A quality primary standing desk and fixed project bench share the work wall. Closed drawers, a charcoal rug and a compact gray visitor chair keep the center open.
proposals.lighting: Use the existing overhead light with a neutral/cool presentation and retain the white ceiling. Keep the white Honeywell task lamp. An optional wall wash creates evening atmosphere.
proposals.tradeoff: Most flexible treatment. Select a quiet finish and test adhesion against the actual wall.
proposals.caption: Inspiration image; actual room geometry and products will be modeled after your choice.

proposals.name: Charcoal + Slat Bay
proposals.tagline: Architectural texture. Black metal. Studio mood.
proposals.vibe: A dark slat bay gives the strongest architectural vibe. Cool charcoal and steel-gray textiles keep the room crisp.
proposals.work_wall: A bounded 1.2–1.8 m slat feature behind the fixed project bench, with charcoal across the surrounding desk wall. Define its edges cleanly within the 3.02 m room height.
proposals.room_translation: Keep the primary standing desk clear as it rises. Pair both work surfaces with quiet art, a charcoal rug, closed storage and a compact gray visitor chair.
proposals.lighting: Use the existing overhead light with a neutral/cool presentation and retain the white ceiling. Keep the white Honeywell lamp. Optional wall-wash light reveals the slat texture in the evening.
proposals.tradeoff: Panel thickness, edges and real mounting details are finalized after your choice. Treat wood panels as a fitted wall treatment.
proposals.caption: Inspiration image; keep the owned white lamp and natural cat tree colors.

proposals.name: Ink Studio
proposals.vibe: Deep blue-black creates a cool, distinct identity. Gray textiles and one pale graphic artwork sharpen the contrast.
proposals.work_wall: Deep ink across the 4.2 m desk wall, using matte paint or a quiet verified peel-and-stick finish. Leave the brick wall exposed.
proposals.room_translation: A primary standing desk and fixed project bench form a clear horizontal work strip. Closed drawers, a quiet gray rug and a compact visitor chair keep the room usable.
proposals.lighting: Use the existing overhead light with a neutral/cool presentation and retain the white ceiling. Keep the white Honeywell task lamp. An optional wall wash creates evening atmosphere.
proposals.tradeoff: Most expressive color choice. Compare a physical sample in daylight and under the room’s overhead light.
proposals.caption: Inspiration image; actual room geometry and products will be modeled after your choice.
